role: MEASUREMENT_NON_FORECASTING — reads results.csv, never writes it

contamination_whole_file.note: These are LEGACY rows predating the owner's 2026-08-16 tier-1-only ruling. They are outside the acquisition window and are NOT introduced by this refresh. They remain visible to the tier-blind production predicate and therefore still feed V13's season-to-date form. Removing them would change a FROZEN model's inputs mid-record (R3) and is an owner decision, not a repair — see harness/tier_discipline.py and data/audit/tier_exposure_baseline.json.

per_date.missing_tier1_games_basis: roster partition only — PROVISIONAL pending schedule manifest
per_date.completeness_basis: all 30 known franchises appear exactly once across 15 canonical tier-1 games, so the board is an internally complete roster partition. This does NOT independently prove the official schedule had exactly 15 games: a doubleheader plus a matching off-day pair would also partition the roster. PROVISIONAL until the exact gamePk set matches a separately captured official schedule manifest.

schedule_manifest.consequence: the game COUNT is not independently verified. missing_tier1_games=0 rests on the roster partition alone and is PROVISIONAL.

required_contents.gamePks: the official gamePk list for this date
required_contents.source: official schedule endpoint or owner-supplied board
required_contents.note: must be captured SEPARATELY from the results board so it is genuinely a second source, not a re-read of the same bytes

schedule_manifest.blocked_by: outbound HTTPS 403 at the org egress proxy; not routed around
